# Filosign - extended summary for AI assistants

> Use this file when you need more context than https://filosign.xyz/llms.txt . All URLs use the production marketing origin unless noted.

## What Filosign is

Filosign is a wallet-native document signing platform for encrypted agreements, verifiable signing records, and permissioned document sharing. Users send documents, collect signatures, export proof packets, and optionally attach USDC payout rules or gated file releases that execute when signing conditions are met. The server never holds plaintext document keys or custodies settlement funds.

Core properties:

- **End-to-end encryption** - Documents are encrypted in the browser before upload. Filosign stores ciphertext and encrypted key envelopes, not readable file contents.
- **Wallet-backed identity** - Embedded wallet (thirdweb) plus app-level post-quantum signing keys derived client-side.
- **On-chain proof on Base** - `FSEnvelopeRegistry` records registration, routing, quorum, and signer state. Compliance bundles combine Merkle placement manifests with chain attestations.
- **Non-custodial settlements** - Optional USDC payout legs via `FSPaymentValidator`; funds move payer to recipient wallets when release conditions pass, without Filosign custody.
- **Decentralized storage** - Hot object storage with Filecoin backup and archival paths documented on-site.

Paid plans (Solo, Teams, Teams Pro) include 7-day free trials. Marketing site: https://filosign.xyz . Pricing: https://filosign.xyz/pricing . Docs: https://filosign.xyz/docs .

## Primary user journeys

1. Connect wallet, complete onboarding, derive local encryption/signing keys (PIN-protected seed).
2. Request permission to send documents to a recipient wallet; recipient approves connection.
3. Create envelope, place signature/date/text/checkbox fields, encrypt document, upload, register on-chain.
4. Recipients acknowledge, decrypt locally, sign; routing order and quorum rules apply.
5. On completion, export a completion/proof ZIP; attached payout or file release may execute automatically.

## Documentation hubs

### Agreement workflows (`/docs/workflows/`)

Guides for sending envelopes, signing order, void/amend flows, encrypted comments, USDC payout packets, gated attachments, release conditions, drafts, and org templates.

Key pages:

- **Signing and routing** - Sign page UX, turn order, quorum, required acknowledgements.
- **Envelope governance** - Void envelopes, propose/execute signer replacement, post-send changes.
- **Payouts** - Attach optional USDC legs; auto-release when conditions met; non-custodial.
- **Attached files** - Release encrypted attachments after signing conditions.
- **Release conditions** - Configure when payouts or file unlocks fire.

### Proof and evidence (`/docs/proof/`)

Completion packet ZIP structure, how to read compliance PDFs, e-signature evidence framing, saved signature library.

### Security and privacy (`/docs/security/`, `/docs/storage/`)

What is encrypted client-side, what operators can see, on-chain verification records, retention (hot + Filecoin), export before archival, in-app storage status.

### Teams and plans (`/docs/workspace/`, `/docs/plans/`)

Workspace roles, billing/seats, treasury wallet, payout access, connections, plan limits, public roadmap of not-yet-shipped catalog items.

### Support

- https://filosign.xyz/help/ - Redirect to in-app Support Center (searchable error catalog in the client app).
- Legacy `/help/errors/*` URLs redirect to a specific Support Center topic.

## Legal and compliance (public pages)

Privacy Policy, Terms, Acceptable Use, Subprocessors (Resend, Hetzner, Cloudflare R2, thirdweb, PostHog, Dodo MoR, etc.), DPA, e-signature validity explainer, non-custodial settlement explainer, settlement addendum. Contact: support@filosign.xyz, privacy@filosign.xyz, security@filosign.xyz.

## Technical stack (for integrators)

Monorepo: https://github.com/filosign-dapp/filosign - React client, Hono API, Solidity contracts (`FSEnvelopeRegistry`, `FSPaymentValidator`), `@filosign/react` SDK, shared Zod schemas, crypto-utils (ML-KEM/Kyber, Dilithium, AES-GCM).
